import json, re
cfg = json.loads(read('renovate.json'))
src = read('versions.toml')
for m in cfg['regexManagers']:
    for ms in m['matchStrings']:
        rx = re.compile(ms)
        found = False
        for line in src.splitlines():
            mt = rx.search(line)
            if mt and 'currentValue' in mt.groupdict():
                found = True
                print(f"matchString: {ms!r}")
                print(f"  line: {line.strip()}")
                print(f"  currentValue={mt['currentValue']!r} -> dep {m['depNameTemplate']} ({m['datasourceTemplate']})")
                ex = re.compile(m['extractVersion']).match(mt['currentValue'])
                print(f"  extractVersion strip: {ex.group('version') if ex else '(no match -> used as-is)'}")
                print(f"  versioning: {m['versioningTemplate']}")
        if not found:
            print(f"NO MATCH for {ms!r}")
        print()

content.text:
Renovate isn't running against this repo at all — the config is fine, the bot has never executed here.

## Evidence

**The config works** (verified against `versions.toml`):
- `smolvm_golden_version` regex manager matches `smolvm_golden_version = "1.8.2"` → dep `smol-machines/smolvm`, `github-releases`, semver. Same for `runner_version` → `actions/runner`.
- Both are pinned correctly, and the pin is stale: smolvm shipped **11 stable releases** since `1.8.2` (v1.8.3 → v1.13.1, latest 2026-08-27). A running Renovate would have opened a bump PR to v1.13.1.

**Renovate has never created anything in `preloopdev/preloop`**:
- `gh pr list --author app/renovate` → **zero** PRs. No onboarding PR, no bump PRs.
- No "Dependency Dashboard" issue exists (it's created on the first run that finds updates).
- No self-hosted Renovate anywhere: no workflow in `.github/workflows/`, no local binary/cron/launchd/docker container.

**Repo is org-owned**: `preloopdev` org created 2026-06-26; the Renovate config landed 2026-08-11 (commits `c5b80084`/`f4d7d940`) — after the org move.

## Diagnosis

The **Renovate GitHub App is not installed on the `preloopdev` org** — the account that owns the repo. The `renovate.json`, `smolvm-release-verify.yml`, and `runner-sync.yml` tripwire wiring are all inert without it. If the app were installed (or ever ran), we'd see at minimum the Dependency Dashboard issue; there's no trace of any run. [Direct install status isn't queryable with the current token — the 401/403 from the installation endpoints is a token limitation, so this is inferred from the total absence of bot activity.]

## Fix (org admin, your action)

1. Go to `github.com/apps/renovate` → **Install** → select the `preloopdev` org → grant repo access to `preloop` (write needed for bump branches/PRs + dashboard issue).
2. Because `renovate.json` already exists, it skips onboarding and starts on its hourly schedule — expect the smolvm bump PR (1.8.2 → 1.13.1) and a Dependency Dashboard issue within the hour, plus the `actions/runner` tripwire PR when upstream moves past 2.336.0.

Caveat from your own config comment: the smolvm auto-merge waits for `smolvm-release-verify.yml`, which is inert until `SMOLVM_VERIFY_HOST_WORKSPACE` is set and a `[self-hosted, smolvm-host]` runner is registered — don't trust auto-merge before that exists.

content.text:
Since the pin (`1.8.2`, 2026-08-15) smolvm shipped **12 releases** (v1.8.3 → v1.13.1, all stable). Grouped by theme, with the release each landed in:

## Networking
- **Named inter-VM networks** with routed addressing between machines (1.8.3)
- `host.smolvm.internal` resolves to the gateway; default `/etc/hosts` when the image ships none (1.8.3)
- Loopback proxy host rewritten to the host's outbound address so guests can reach it (1.12.0)
- Guest IPv6 gated on real host reachability, resolver defaulted **IPv4-first** (1.10.1)
- libkrunfw guest kernel with **IPv4/IPv6 policy routing** — TUN-based VPN/proxy clients work (1.10.1)
- Guest TCP FIN forwarded properly in the virtio-net relay (1.8.3)

## Remote volumes / S3
- `--volume` can mount **S3 and any rclone remote** (1.10.0/1.10.1); agent mounts S3 natively, no rclone needed in the image (1.10.1)
- Remote volumes carried on every exec, on the embedded machine spec (SDK machines), and on ephemeral runs without a persistent overlay (1.11.0/1.11.1)

## Packing / image fidelity
- Default `/etc/hosts` provided (1.8.3); **auto-shrink disk by reclaiming freed blocks to the host** (1.9.0)
- Disk auto-grows an existing storage/overlay to the requested size instead of booting the stale one (1.9.2) — relevant to preloop's storage sizing
- Archive-flatten scratch staged on the storage disk instead of guest tmpfs; damaged layer caches rebuilt from the source artifact (1.9.1/1.9.2)
- Pack-export reads get one consistent ceiling (1.8.3 — yours); pre-1.13 packs extracted host-side when they predate in-guest unpacking (1.13.0)

## Forking / checkpoints
- Forkable golden survives config-change VM restarts; keep-alive container reused for fork-clone exec instead of a fresh container per call (1.9.1)
- **Transactional embedded batch forking**, hardened forked workloads (1.12.0); **nested machine checkpoints** (1.13.0); **portable live checkpoints** and fork checkpoints preserved across runtime restarts (1.13.1)

## GPU / display
- Segmented CUDA graph capture (1.9.0); automatic CUDA replay + distributed multi-GPU (1.9.2)
- Bundled Venus Vulkan driver injected into GPU workload containers; driver pinned only when the container has the bundle; mounted into pod/overlay containers too (1.9.0/1.12.0)
- **Opt-in virtio-gpu scanout + VNC** with virtio-input — interactive Linux desktop; VNC port now serves a browser client (1.12.0/1.13.1)

## Reliability / platform
- Broken blob downloads resume with bound retry instead of hanging machine create (1.10.1)
- Release lookup **fails instead of falling back to hardcoded 0.1.1** (1.13.0); expired registry-token warning instead of bare 401 (1.13.1)
- macOS: `libkrun.dylib` Homebrew refs relocated to `@loader_path` so packed launchers boot (1.9.2); missing hypervisor entitlement named on boot -22 (1.9.0 — yours); net-enabled libkrun restored (1.8.0); aarch64-KVM snapshot + fork support (1.9.2)
- Windows krun.dll rebuilt so machines boot on WHP again (1.10.1)
- Egress policy enforced even when served from the image cache; egress denials recorded per machine (1.9.0/1.8.1)
- cgroup2 controllers delegated at agent boot; unknown fields rejected on exec/run API (1.9.0/1.9.2); h2 bumped to clear RUSTSEC-2026-0258 (1.9.0)

## Worth flagging for preloop
- **1.9.2's `@loader_path` relocation** — `preloop update --ensure-runtime` on macOS installs "latest stable ≥ 1.8.1"; packed-launcher boot was broken before 1.9.2, so the floor's minimum is fine but the runtime floor comment ("first release satisfying all invariants") predates it.
- 1.13.0's fail-fast release lookup is a behavior preloop's `--ensure-runtime` interacts with (no silent 0.1.1 fallback).
- Your own PRs shipped in this window: pack-export read ceiling (1.8.3), macOS entitlement message (1.9.0), flatten EAGAIN window + post-`--` option validation + storage disk grow (1.9.2), mount-socket collision fix (1.8.0).

The renovate bump would go 1.8.2 → **1.13.1**; the smolvm-release-verify E2E gate exists precisely because the disk-grow and egress changes touch preloop's VM lifecycle.
